subject: TDX Healthcare — regional latency surge and request for cross-region handoff

From: Kevin Lin <kevin.lin@tdxhealth.com>

Cc: aisha.tdx@tdxhealth.com
Date: Mon, 13 Nov 2028 07:12:00 -0800
Subject: TDX production latency / 5xx spike - US-WEST1

Laura —

We started seeing a sharp latency increase across our patient ingestion pipeline this morning around 06:50 PST and a concurrent spike in 5xx responses from the Redwood API. Error rate jumped from ~0.2% to ~4.8% and p95 latency moved from ~150ms to ~1.6s. This is impacting downstream processing and SLA windows.

Attached a short log excerpt and a PNG with the last 90 minutes of RTTs. Can you confirm whether this is isolated to us-west-1 or if you’re seeing broader region degradation? We need a temporary routing workaround if you recommend moving traffic.

We’re available on a quick bridge if helpful — Kevin (TDX Infra)

Attachments: tdx_error_samples.log, tdx_graphs_11-13.png

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, Kevin Lin <kevin.lin@tdxhealth.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Nov 2028 07:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: TDX production latency / 5xx spike - US-WEST1

Quick diagnostic notes (initial):
- Observed elevated 5xx rates from several host pools in us-west-1 starting 06:48 PST. Error signatures point to transient KV cache thrashing + increased prefix cache miss rate for long-context requests.
- CPU on a subset of GPUs is normal; latency appears tied to hot partitions in the model serving layer and increased batching queuing due to a small subset of long sequences.
- Smart routing logs show a partial fallback trigger but some sessions remained pinned to us-west-1 due to client pinning and cookie affinity.

Recommended immediate actions:
1) Authorize a brief traffic redirection for the TDX prod namespace to us-east-1 (gradual 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 10m windows) to relieve hot partitions.
2) Enable aggressive prefix/KV caching for TDX namespace in us-east-1 to reduce cold startup impact.
3) Temporarily lower max sequence length enforcement for TDX to reduce queue amplification (we'll surface any potential truncation impact).

If you authorize, I’ll open the routing change now and post a runbook link. There will be a short period of increased tail latency as caches warm in the target region.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
SRE, Redwood Inference
On-call: paged via PagerDuty

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: Kevin Lin <kevin.lin@tdxhealth.com>, aisha.tdx@tdxhealth.com
Date: Mon, 13 Nov 2028 08:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: TDX production latency / 5xx spike - US-WEST1

Status update for leadership and TDX execs — request for approval to perform cross-region handoff. Please treat as P1 communication.

What happened: an abrupt spike in prefix cache miss rate and KV cache invalidation in us-west-1 produced a cascade of queuing on the serving runtime for TDX long-context requests, pushing p95 to ~1.6s and 5xx to ~4.8%. Rishi's diagnostic indicates the problem is concentrated on a small set of hot partitions in us-west-1; we expect relief if we shift traffic.

Ask (requires approvals):
- Approve immediate graduated traffic redirection to us-east-1 for the TDX prod namespace (documented fallback runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2199).
- Allow SRE to apply temporary conservative sequence-length caps and enable aggressive KV/prefix caching in the target region.

Impact notes for customer:
- Short window (~5-12 minutes) of increased p95 as caches warm in the target region.
- Potentially higher token cost during the warm-up.
- No expected data loss — control plane and logs retained.

Marissa — can you check whether TDX legal/procurement needs notification for the cross-region shift? Kevin — if you can confirm we can proceed on your side, we’ll start the shift immediately and invite you on the bridge (meeting invite attached).

—Laura

==== Forwarded incident runbook ====

Subject: Re: TDX production latency / 5xx spike - US-WEST1

Thanks all — update from our side: after the staged redirect to us-east-1 and Rishi's cache tuning, error rate dropped back to ~0.25% within 9 minutes and p95 returned to ~170ms within 15 minutes. We’ll keep monitoring overnight and will reopen if anything recurs.

TDX note: we did observe one job that requeued due to session affinity drop; engineering will tighten session persistence on our end for future cross-region moves. Appreciate the quick coordination and transparency.

Kevin
TDX Infrastructure Ops
